titulo: Cop31 live: EU and others reject deal as longest climate summit ever faces collapse
cuerpo: Another version of the draft text has been published and negotiators have been called in for the final session Full report: Climate talks stall as countries mull showdown with Saudi Arabia over fossil fuel phaseout Mohamed Adow, director of Power Shift Africa, has been looking through the text and says: “This latest text is a total mess and countries should throw it out. It fails to deliver vital climate finance to the vulnerable while promoting far-fetched and eye wateringly expensive carbon removal technologies which is a gift to the fossil fuel industry. “A sign of how useless the latest cover text is can be seen in the feeble language. It ‘recognises’ the crisis 40 times, ‘recalls’ previous decisions 15 times yet ‘decides’ on action only 5 times. And those 5 decisions relate to peripheral issues. This meeting needs to be about turning those previous commitments into action, and on that it has failed.” Continue reading...
